## TickOutOfRangeError class

Thrown when a tick exceeds the deployed TickLib range.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class TickOutOfRangeError extends Error
```
**Extends:** Error

## Example


```ts
import { TickOutOfRangeError } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";

const error = new TickOutOfRangeError(7000n, 6744n);
console.log(error.message);
```
